Agent Name: Planner

, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Best Day Ever was released on June 2, 2016 based on an initial Genius result, failing to distinguish the 2016 commercial re-release from the original mixtape release on March 11, 2011. This misinterpretation of sources led to the wrong date.
